purpose: One fixed correction to whole-line timing coverage loss, after rejecting an all-raw DTW alternative for increased paired start error.
exposure: All30 conservative-v3 vocal results and15 instrumental controls, plus the completed all-raw timing comparison, are known. This is exposed regression testing, not a fresh independent holdout.
source: Cached original native/SDK segments and native-word evidence from the frozen small seed0 runs; no further ASR.
rules: Keep coarse-v3 lexical masking/recovery/native-validity decisions exactly, including no-speech/logprob, compression2.4, ordinary probability0.35 and weak-window recovery0.70.
Determine non-lyric caption omission from the same whole-line coarse-v3 grouping before splitting. Preserve source token order; reject any inconsistent ordering rather than guessing.
Create a unit per retained word. Publish the actual raw DTW interval when both SDK/native spans are valid and their maximum boundary difference is<=0.20seconds.
When the maximum boundary difference is>0.20seconds, retain the word text only in an uncertain coarse unit with words:[], using the envelope of the actual raw and SDK boundaries.

Resolve all connected overlaps on individual units, merging backwards as necessary. Any overlapping component becomes one uncertain coarse span with source-ordered text and actual endpoint envelope. Never trim or redistribute word spans.
Only after overlap resolution, group consecutive reliable units belonging to the same original ASR segment. Do not merge reliable units across a coarse component or caption boundary.
Generate ALL30 vocal and15 instrumental hypotheses before opening human references. No per-song tuning or threshold changes.

predeclaredChecks.text: Identical normalized lexical/uncertainty-token sequence to coarse-v3 for all45 outputs; WER therefore unchanged.
predeclaredChecks.negative: Zero lexical lyric words on all15 instrumental controls; report ellipsis-only spans separately.
predeclaredChecks.timing: Report paired start/end MAE on common reference positions, all per-song changes, exact timed coverage and remaining gap to same-native legacy. A pooled MAE increase>0.020seconds or any song increase>0.050seconds is a material regression that blocks promotion.
predeclaredChecks.coverage: Require a substantial gain over coarse-v3; do not describe a smaller timed subset's MAE as improved synchronization.
predeclaredChecks.integration: Actual client validator and real model/shared HTTP smoke required before production promotion.

historicalTextRegressionRemains: Frozenv3 EN20 has2351 errors versus2257 in historicalv1; this timing-only experiment cannot fix or hide that difference.
